what: "Brienne Gil" (pseudonym): Domestika made CGMA instructors self-market
verbatim_snippet: "After the acquisition, Brienne Gil*, a CGMA instructor, mentioned that Domestika asked the instructors to market their own courses, which led to a drop in enrollments."
notes: Original ID: Finding 19. Speaker: Brienne Gil* (pseudonym), CGMA instructor; Platform: Class Central; Category: frustration, before_after; Access method: Search snippet.

extra_fields.additional_detail: "Brienne also learned from a CGMA employee that Domestika had allegedly promised to keep the CGMA facility running for 5 years. But on November 14, 2024, CGMA filed a Certificate of Dissolution."
